value.rules_markdown:
- Return `Result<T>` using the crate error type from `src/error.rs`.
- Every file opens with a `//!` module doc describing its role and any feature gating.
- Comments explain the decision, not the code.
- Public items carry doc comments; Clap fields use `///` to become help text.
- Tests live in-crate with a `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` block; move to a sibling file when they grow.
- Every port has an always-compiled offline mock.
- Lane behaviour is covered by golden tests.
- Maintain at least 80% coverage for meaningful library behaviour.
- Keep every Markdown file at 500 lines or fewer; split and link when it grows.
- The model never holds a write token; lanes run against a read-only checkout.
- Contributor code is never executed.
- Pull request bodies, comments, and diffs are untrusted input.
- Secrets found by scanners are reported by type and location only, never the value.
- Use concise imperative commit subjects.
- Keep commits small; commit each validated slice on its own.
